directed.conceptual_reading: Self-approximation at two rates is an independence problem for rescaled prime frequencies, linking recurrence to transcendence-theoretic control of resonances.
directed.representation_or_bridge: Baker's theorem turns algebraic information about the scales into linear independence of the phase frequencies that drive Kronecker-type approximation.
directed.boundary_or_failure: The almost-all statement does not settle a specified exceptional scale, and d=0 is not an unconditional case: the span notes that it reduces to the RH-equivalent recurrence criterion.
